scope: Investigate a per-send exclusion index for group sends only. F012 broadcast exclusions, F013 targeted sends and F014 user membership remain independent.
prerequisites: Use an independent source branch from the campaign baseline, not the preceding F010 source commit.
Capture selected baseline/working/fresh-default source triples, owner history, related Fowler PR69189 and applicable documentation.

Build the original owner and run the complete discovered DefaultHubLifetimeManagerTests class, including inherited specification cases. Parse every actual TRX identity, execution, outcome and theory row.

Exercise public OnConnectedAsync, AddToGroupAsync and SendGroupExceptAsync with actual HubConnectionContext, SerializedHubMessage and JsonHubProtocol. Observe actual transport frame bytes and recipients, not a copied filter.

Characterize missing groups, case sensitivity, duplicate exclusions, all-excluded laziness, original ICollection.Contains dispatch and sequential live collection changes produced by a real JSON-serialized argument property getter; do not inject the lifetime-manager filter or protocol callbacks.
Use actual bounded Pipes to characterize pending writes, completion after draining every recipient, and cancellation; no sleeps or injected lifetime-manager callbacks.
Establish repeated miss enumeration with an untimed instrumented input collection. Never time instrumentation.
decision_gates: A candidate must preserve observable collection dispatch, live caller-owned input behavior, lazy serialization, actual delivery, pending-write completion and cancellation.
A snapshot counterfactual is not an implemented candidate or red/green optimization. Reject an incompatible proposal honestly; do not claim all other compatible designs are impossible.
Do not duplicate the separate small-target SendConnectionsAsync change in upstream PR69189 or reuse its measurements.
If no compatible candidate is selected, one original-only diagnostic profile may quantify the real synchronous group-send boundary. It is not a before/after comparison or an improvement claim.

Any compatible candidate needs the same compiled harness and otherwise identical captured consumer images across original/candidate roles, focused regression coverage, actual applicable API gates and at most three measured comparisons including failed or partial attempts.
timing_boundary: Repeated actual public group send over pre-registered/grouped real HubConnectionContexts, real per-send JSON serialization and synchronous bounded transport writers. No unbounded Pipe growth, network, handshake, connection creation or production-frequency claim. Async/backpressure/cancellation are separately characterized with actual Pipes, not timed.
host: Shared Windows VM; serialize CPU-heavy builds/tests/profiles; maximum two build nodes; no deliberate power, priority, affinity or unrelated-process changes.
current_default_protocol_delta: The original source-triple reader correctly stopped on JsonHubProtocol.cs. Preserve that failed reader and actual header-enumeration delta, then validate the relevant captured-default producer instead of claiming universal source equivalence.
